description_en: Updates an approval process under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 更新当前阿里云账号下审批流程
name: UpdateApprovalProcess

parameters.help_en: The name of the approval process. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: process_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the approval process. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list of approval nodes. You can define up to 5 approval nodes
parameters.help_zh: 审批节点列表。最多可定义5个审批节点
parameters.name: process_nodes
